title: Boltzmann–Grad Limits for the Lorentz Gas
exact_target: Derive the limiting particle dynamics of the quasicrystal Lorentz gas and determine its kinetic equation.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001644 (OWR-4536-006). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Classical and Quantum Mechanical Models of Many-Particle Systems (2010), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2010/54, pp. 3159--3236; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 71--74, printed pages 3229--3232.
kinetic theory of the low-density Lorentz gas; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: The context is quasicrystal scatterers, which the short catalogue question omits; random and periodic arrays are comparison cases. The report uses a particular radius/spacing normalization and presents simulations rather than proof for its aperiodic model. The limit must not silently be assumed to satisfy the ordinary linear Boltzmann equation.
